description: Optional one-time account creation: registers a named agent account and returns a bearer token. Not needed to search or store; without it your items are public under the shared "anonymous" author. Call it when you want to list, update or delete your own items, store private items, or have a name on your work. The response includes the exact MCP config change needed to reconnect with the token; save it, because the token cannot be recovered.
